### Q1
No. The user rejected migrating to SQLite. Ops backs up `data/store.json` with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, and a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. We kept the JSON store and sped it up with debounced writes instead.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any changes would vanish.

### Q3
The HMAC goes in a top-level body field `sig`. It is the hex HMAC-SHA256 over the JSON body without `sig`, and the secret comes from the env var `ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. We first tried an `X-Signature` header, but the ERP API gateway strips all custom `X-` headers, so the ERP saw everything as unsigned on staging.

### Q4
Port 9911. It moved from 8080 in October.

### Q5
All new user-facing errors need a German `message`, because it is shown verbatim in the packers' UI. The `code` must be English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English validation messages stay as they are.

### Q6
Austrian public holidays are hardcoded for 2026 and 2027 in `src/services/holidays.ts`. The deployment has no outbound internet, so they can't be fetched. 2028 and later must be added by hand.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload and accepts only one event object per request. The user tried batching in September.

### Q8
Don't add any npm packages, runtime or dev. Each one goes through a security review that takes about 6 weeks, so we use only what Node provides.

### Q9
A cached version existed earlier, and QA found a stale-ETA bug in it. The list kept the old ETA after a new exception event, and a proper cache key got messy. The user ruled out caching and memoizing ETAs for good, so `calculateEta` is computed fresh on every call. Pagination of `GET /shipments` is the planned fix for slowness.

### Q10
There are 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s pause and no backoff. Only network errors, timeouts and 5xx responses are retried. The ERP dedups by `event_id` only within 2 minutes, and the worst-case last attempt starts at about 70 s, so a test guards that budget.

### Q11
Never log recipient names, addresses or phone numbers, and never log recipient objects. This is a GDPR rule the DPO flagged in last month's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, "emits webhook on delivered" in `test/events.test.ts` is flaky, failing in roughly 1 of 5 CI runs. It is a timer race in the fake notifier (OPS-412), and the platform team owns the fix. If it fails, rerun once and do not edit the test.

### Q13
ATP numbers are validated strictly as UPU S10, including the check digit. Every other carrier accepts any non-empty value. This is deliberately loose, because strict checks rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days last year.

### Q14
`fs.watch` stays silent on staging. The config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host, so change events get lost. `fs.watchFile` (polling) works, as the user tried last week. Nothing needs to be built now, since hot reload is only a future idea.

### Q15
`GET /shipments/:id` must stay exactly as it is, with no fields added or removed. Mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and the next mobile release is in January. Only the list endpoint `GET /shipments` gets `eta`.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker — autonomous feature work, user reviews at the end
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- parcel-tracker = Vienna warehouse shipment tracking (Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps). User gives tasks one by one, works autonomously, reviews everything at the end (user).
- Done (all uncommitted, 105 tests green, last verified 2026-11-17): holidays in ETA; ATP S10 validation; ERP `sig` + retries + payload field names; list `eta`; request logging; debounced store writes. Details in Rules/Decisions/Facts below.

## Rules
- (user) NO caching/memoization of ETAs, ever — QA found a stale-ETA bug with a cached version (list kept the old ETA after a new exception event) and a proper cache key got messy. calculateEta stays computed fresh on every call. Instead: paginate GET /shipments later (user, not started). Tests "is never stale" / "drops the eta" in test/shipments-list-eta.test.ts guard this.
- (user) GDPR (DPO flagged it in last month audit): NEVER log recipient names, addresses, phone numbers (no recipient objects in any log). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must stay EXACTLY as is (same fields, nothing added/removed): mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. Only the list (GET /shipments) gets `eta`. Do not add fields to shipmentToApi (shared by both).
- (user) Do NOT modify src/legacy/ — vendored from the old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes vanish.
- (user) No new npm packages, dev ones included — each goes through security review (~6 weeks). Use only what Node provides.
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ATP = strict UPU S10 incl. check digit (docs/carriers.md); ALL other carriers = any non-empty value, loose on purpose (last year strict checks rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days).
- (user) All NEW user-facing errors: `message` in German (shown verbatim in packers UI), `code` English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English validation messages left as is.
- (user) Flaky test "emits webhook on delivered" (test/events.test.ts, ~1 in 5 CI runs, timer race in fake notifier, OPS-412, platform team owns fix): if red, rerun once, do NOT edit the test.

## Decisions
- ERP retries (notify.ts postToErpWithRetry): 3 attempts total, fixed 30 s pause, no backoff, retry only network errors/timeouts/5xx (not 4xx — my choice); sleep injectable (user). Reason: ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 min; worst case last attempt starts at 2*(30s+5s timeout)=70s; a test guards this budget (raising delay/attempts/timeoutMs can break it). Notifier is fire-and-forget (`void notify`), retries never delay HTTP responses; retries are in-memory, lost on restart.
- ERP signing: top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON body WITHOUT sig (sig appended last, key order kept); secret only from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (user). If unset: send unsigned + one-time warn (my choice; keeps local sandbox working, ERP will 401 once ERP-1182 enforces).
- Austrian holidays: hardcoded 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts — because deployment has zero outbound internet (user). Easter-based dates computed by me, user should verify; 2028+ must be added.
- ATP validation lives in src/lib/trackingNumber.ts, called from validate.ts, so POST /import applies it too (per-line German errors) — my choice, told user.
